title: Non-blocking follow-ups from backend-cftc-cot-caching-scheduler's PR #380 review
description: Non-blocking findings from the PR #380 review of backend-cftc-cot-caching-scheduler (whose blocking finding -- docs/architecture/Backend.md §9 and docs/architecture/API.md's GET /api/cftc/cot section describing the endpoint as having no local caching, now false -- was recorded directly on that task's own review.comments and sent back for rework, since it's blocking). These two items are secondary/lower-severity gaps surfaced by the same review pass; file here per CLAUDE.md's 'every non-blocking finding becomes a tracked task' convention so they aren't lost once the PR merges.

checklist.step: docs/architecture/Backend.md §2's module-layout tree (the `data/` directory listing) doesn't mention the new `cftc_cot_cache.py` file, and §7's cache-table enumeration prose doesn't mention the new `cftc_cot_cache` table either. Likely to get fixed incidentally when the PR's blocking §9/API.md doc-staleness finding is addressed, but worth confirming explicitly rather than assuming -- fold into that same doc pass if it hasn't already landed by the time this is picked up.

`app.main._cftc_cot_refresh_loop` has no dedicated test exercising the 'shutdown doesn't block on an in-flight refresh call' path, unlike `_ibkr_tickle_loop`'s own `TestLifespanIbkrTickleGate.test_shutdown_does_not_block_on_an_in_flight_tickle_call` (born from a real timing bug per that test's own docstring). The CFTC loop uses the identical `asyncio.to_thread` + `Future.cancel()` cancellation mechanism, so this is very likely already correct, but it's untested specifically for this loop -- add an equivalent test (slow/blocking `_refresh_cftc_cot_cache_if_stale` stand-in, cancel mid-flight, assert `lifespan()`'s shutdown returns promptly) for parity and to guard against a future divergence between the two loops' shutdown behavior.

[round 2 PR #380 review, non-blocking] `CFTCCOTCache.refresh()` (app/data/cftc_cot_cache.py) commits every market's upserts in a single transaction rather than per-entity (unlike `CachedDataProvider._upsert`/`_upsert_extended`, which commit once per ticker) -- a single PK-collision on any one row (the scheduled loop racing a concurrent on-demand cache-miss fetch) discards the whole ~260-row batch's writes, not just the colliding row (`test_integrity_error_on_commit_is_swallowed_not_raised` itself demonstrates this: the row count is 0, not 259, after the swallowed collision). Not a correctness bug -- the rollback+log-never-raise race-safety behavior is intact -- just wasteful, forcing an unnecessarily early full re-fetch. Consider committing per-market (or per-row) instead, matching the established convention elsewhere in this file.

[round 3 PR #380 re-review, non-blocking] `frontend/src/api/types.ts` (the generated client, `yarn generate:api-types`) was not regenerated after `backend/openapi.json`'s `GET /api/cftc/cot` description changed in this PR -- confirmed by re-running `yarn generate:api-types` from `frontend/` and diffing: only the JSDoc description comment for that one operation differs (still says "Always fetches fresh from the CFTC's own public Socrata endpoint (no local caching..."), no actual type/schema/shape changed, so `tsc`/`eslint` both stay clean either way and nothing is functionally broken. Not blocking since it's a comment-only drift in a generated artifact with no behavioral effect, but `docs/architecture/API.md`'s "Frontend Type Generation" section documents this file as meant to track `backend/openapi.json` to prevent contract drift -- worth regenerating and committing `frontend/src/api/types.ts` to close this gap next time this file (or any other route whose docstring changes) is touched.

decisions.decision: Both checklist items were folded directly into `backend-cftc-cot-caching-scheduler`'s own PR #380 rework (its needs_work rework pass) rather than done here separately: the Backend.md §2/§7 doc mentions were added in the same doc-editing pass as that PR's blocking §9/API.md fix, and `TestLifespanCftcCotRefreshLoop.test_shutdown_does_not_block_on_an_in_flight_refresh_call` was added to `backend/tests/unit/test_main.py` in that same PR, mirroring `TestLifespanIbkrTickleGate`'s identical IBKR-loop test and mutation-tested against a reverted `cftc_cot_refresh_task.cancel()` call to confirm it actually catches a regression.
decisions.rationale: Per CLAUDE.md's 'every non-blocking finding becomes a tracked task' convention, this task exists to make sure these two findings aren't lost -- now that they're actually fixed (landed on `main` via PR #380), marking them done here (rather than leaving them open for a second, now-redundant pass) keeps this board entry accurate rather than stale. No code/decision here was reversed or reinterpreted; this is purely a status update reflecting work already completed on the dependency task's own PR.

decisions.decision: The third checklist item (CFTCCOTCache.refresh()'s single-commit-per-batch granularity, filed by the round-2 review's reversal comment) was also fixed directly on `backend-cftc-cot-caching-scheduler`'s own PR #380, in the same push as that PR's round-3 blocking fixture-mode-gate fix, rather than left deferred here: `refresh()` now commits once per market inside its existing per-market loop, matching `CachedDataProvider._upsert`/`_upsert_extended`'s per-entity granularity. A PK-collision on one market's row now only discards that market's writes, confirmed by a new test (`test_does_not_discard_other_markets_writes_when_one_markets_commit_collides`, backend/tests/unit/data/test_cftc_cot_cache.py) asserting the other 4 markets' rows survive a collision on the first.
decisions.rationale: Judged small and well-contained (moving an existing try/commit/except block inside an already-existing loop, no new design needed) while already touching this exact file/function for the blocking fixture-mode fix in the same PR -- the dispatch instructions for that round explicitly allowed fixing it now if small, deferring otherwise; this was small enough to fix rather than defer a second time.

decisions.decision: The fourth checklist item (stale `frontend/src/api/types.ts` JSDoc comment) was also fixed directly, during this round-4 rework pass on `backend-cftc-cot-caching-scheduler`'s own PR #380: re-ran `yarn generate:api-types` from `frontend/` and committed the regenerated `src/api/types.ts`. Confirmed the resulting diff is exactly what the review predicted -- only the `GET /api/cftc/cot` operation's JSDoc description comment changed (now describing the DB-backed cache + scheduled refresh instead of the stale "always fetches fresh, no local caching" wording), no type/schema/shape changed -- and that `tsc --noEmit` stays clean.
decisions.rationale: Judged low-risk per the dispatch instructions' own framing (comment-only drift, no shape change, already confirmed clean by the round-3 review's own dry-run diff) -- regenerating and committing a generated artifact from its already-committed source (`backend/openapi.json`) carries essentially no risk of introducing a real bug, so there was no reason to leave it deferred a second time now that it's this cheap to close.

decisions.decision: Closing this task formally: all 4 checklist items were independently re-verified against `main` (merge commit afb89a0a, PR #380) rather than just trusting the three prior `decisions` entries' own claims, and all 4 genuinely hold. Setting `state` to `done` and moving the file to `docs/tasks/done/`. Verified directly: (1) `docs/architecture/Backend.md` line 25 lists `cftc_cot_cache.py` in the §2 module tree and line 109's §7 cache-table prose names the `cftc_cot_cache` table, its key, and its owning classes; (2) `backend/tests/unit/test_main.py`'s `TestLifespanCftcCotRefreshLoop.test_shutdown_does_not_block_on_an_in_flight_refresh_call` (line 435) exists and mirrors `TestLifespanIbkrTickleGate`'s equivalent IBKR test, asserting shutdown returns well before a slow in-flight refresh's sleep completes; (3) `backend/app/data/cftc_cot_cache.py`'s `CFTCCOTCache.refresh()` commits inside its per-market `for market_key, reports in reports_by_market.items()` loop (not once for the whole batch), with `backend/tests/unit/data/test_cftc_cot_cache.py::test_does_not_discard_other_markets_writes_when_one_markets_commit_collides` (line 200) asserting the other markets' rows survive a collision on one; (4) `frontend/src/api/types.ts`'s `GET /api/cftc/cot` JSDoc now describes the DB-backed cache and weekly scheduled refresh (`Served from a DB-backed cache (...) kept fresh by a weekly scheduled background refresh`) rather than the old "always fetches fresh, no local caching" wording.
decisions.rationale: This task's own board-bookkeeping gap (checklist all `done: true` but `state` left at `planned`, because the fixes landed through the parent task's PR #380 rather than this task's own PR) was flagged by `pr-decision` during PR #380's merge review. Per CLAUDE.md's task-board conventions, a task whose actual work is complete should reach `state: done` and move to `docs/tasks/done/` regardless of which PR branch the commits physically landed on -- the checklist items and their dependency on `backend-cftc-cot-caching-scheduler` already make that provenance explicit, and re-verifying against `main` directly (rather than re-trusting the earlier entries) is what makes this closure itself a genuine, independently-checkable verification pass rather than a second copy of the same unverified claim.

review.notes: Pure bookkeeping closure, no application code changed (diff is exactly docs/tasks/done/backend-cftc-cot-caching-scheduler-followups.json + docs/tasks/index.json). Independently re-verified all 4 of the task's claims against current main (afb89a0a) myself rather than trusting the worker's decisions entry: (1) docs/architecture/Backend.md line 25 (§2 module tree) lists cftc_cot_cache.py and line 109 (§7) names the cftc_cot_cache table/key/owning classes; (2) backend/tests/unit/test_main.py::TestLifespanCftcCotRefreshLoop::test_shutdown_does_not_block_on_an_in_flight_refresh_call exists; (3) backend/app/data/cftc_cot_cache.py's CFTCCOTCache.refresh() commits inside its per-market for-loop (confirmed by reading the function source directly), with test_does_not_discard_other_markets_writes_when_one_markets_commit_collides covering it; (4) frontend/src/api/types.ts's GET /api/cftc/cot JSDoc now describes the DB-backed cache + weekly scheduled refresh, and grep confirms zero remaining occurrences of the stale 'no local caching'/'always fetches fresh' wording. Ran backend pytest+coverage as baseline (1572 passed, 100% coverage), ruff+mypy clean, frontend tsc+eslint clean (neither touched by this PR but run per process), and scripts/validate_tasks.py (363 files, no violations). No UI surface touched, so browser walkthrough (step 9) and e2e suite (step 9a) don't apply -- explicitly skipped. No non-blocking findings to track as a follow-up task. No stale pr_decision existed on this task prior to this review.
